en.title: Saying Commands with Falling Tone
en.summary: Learn how to speak Romanian commands with a crisp rhythm and a sharp falling tone.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: A command tells someone to act right now. Your voice starts high and drops fast. The melody does not go up at the end. It falls down hard. Listen to (Vino aici!) /ˈvi.no aˈitʃʲ/, which means come here. The pitch drops sharply on the last part.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Push air quickly from your chest. Start the command with strong energy. Make the first stressed part loud and clear. Then, drop your pitch right away. Do not drag the sounds out. Listen to (Taci!) /tatʃʲ/, which means be quiet. Cut the final sound short and firm.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Look for an exclamation mark at the end. This mark shows high energy and a direct order. Read the whole phrase in one breath. Never pause in the middle. Keep the rhythm quick and decisive. Your tone must fall all the way down.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Many people raise their voice at the end. That makes a command sound like a question. Do not let your pitch rise. Another mistake is speaking too slowly. Do not stretch the ending. Keep the final sound short, flat, and low. A command must sound crisp and firm.
